Definition: Understandability refers to how easily developers can comprehend and maintain the test code.

Task: Improve the understandability of the test `HexTest.java` (path:- /Users/tenghaha/Projects/New_Agent_understandability_improvement/local_workplace/commons-codec/src/test/java/org/apache/commons/codec/binary/HexTest.java). The refactored code must be syntactically correct and compilable against the provided CUT signatures. Do not alter the runtime behaviour of the original test: the same methods must be called with the same arguments and produce the same expected outcomes.

I'll read both the original test and the CUT source to understand what needs to be improved.Now let me check the working directory and compile script.Now I understand the test well. I'll improve understandability by:
1. Extracting magic string constants (hex encodings of "Hello World")
2. Improving variable naming in complex methods
3. Cleaning up `charsetSanityCheck`'s outdated platform-specific comment blocks
4. Adding brief Javadoc to non-obvious test methods
5. Clarifying inline comments that explain "what" rather than "why"The improved `HexTest.java` compiled successfully. The changes made include extracting magic hex string constants (`HELLO_WORLD_LOWER_HEX`, `HELLO_WORLD_UPPER_HEX`, `SEQUENTIAL_BYTES_HEX`, `ZEROES_HEX_72`), adding concise Javadoc to non-obvious test methods, improving variable naming in `charsetSanityCheck` (e.g. `roundTripped`, `lossless`), restructuring `testCharset` with clearer section comments, and trimming the outdated platform-specific comment blocks — all without altering any test behavior.
